capability.transparentOutputConsequence: Contact Sheet requires one opaque paper/contact surface to preserve whole-sheet identity. Transparent export is unavailable; capability copy must disable alpha export rather than faking transparency. This alpha limitation does not change Project audio intent or create an audio side effect.

controls.label: Columns
controls.persistenceMeaning: Discrete column policy used to compile ordered rows, cell dimensions, source wells, and label bands for the canvas.
controls.evaluatorConsequence: Recompiles columns/rows/cell bounds while preserving Project source order, failed cells, source treatment, and traversal semantics.
controls.causalTest: For twelve sources on 1920×1080, options 2 and 6 must produce different rows/cell sizes with identical identity order and no overlap.

controls.label: Gutter
controls.persistenceMeaning: Physical separation between non-overlapping ordered cells.
controls.evaluatorConsequence: Changes inter-cell distance and cell dimensions inside fixed grid bounds; source order and focus traversal order are unchanged.
controls.causalTest: At one canvas/count, 10 and 72 must change adjacent cell spacing and size; all IDs/rows/columns remain valid and non-overlapping.

controls.label: Sheet margin
controls.persistenceMeaning: Inset from opaque paper edge to ordered grid bounds.
controls.evaluatorConsequence: Changes grid bounds and all cell dimensions/positions through one layout recompile; paper remains full-canvas opaque.
controls.causalTest: At 4 and 16, grid width/height and cell positions must differ while source order, count, and source treatment remain equal.

controls.label: Focus traversal
controls.persistenceMeaning: Attention ordinal mapping over immutable source-order cells.
controls.evaluatorConsequence: Changes registration-mark visit order and travel path only; cell geometry, source order, labels, and source pixels are bit-for-bit structurally equal.
controls.causalTest: All three options must produce distinct traversal arrays where applicable while every cell x/y/width/height remains equal.

controls.label: Labels
controls.persistenceMeaning: Visibility of editorial index and caption bands outside source pixels.
controls.evaluatorConsequence: Changes label-band/source-well allocation and visible label records inside each fixed outer cell; outer grid topology and source treatment remain equal.
controls.causalTest: All four options preserve outer cell bounds/order. None yields zero label height; both exposes both label roles without changing source opacity/filter.
